candidate.change: Model Runner V2 adds an online per-position acceptance estimator for adaptive speculative verification, allowing draft-logit-derived acceptance estimates when a trained confidence head is unavailable.

runtimeContract.feature: per-position draft-distribution log-odds mapped to acceptance probability and calibrated online while serving
runtimeContract.adaptiveBudget: verification slots are admitted under the existing adaptive cost budget rather than a fixed speculative depth
runtimeContract.confidenceHeadRelationship: trained DSpark confidence head remains authoritative when available; estimator is the successor path when adaptive verification lacks that head

upstreamDocCodeDrift.documentationStatement: Adaptive verification is currently documented as supported only for DSpark with a confidence head.
upstreamDocCodeDrift.codeObservation: Current source contains an acceptance-estimator path used when adaptive verification is enabled and disables it when a trained DSpark confidence head is present.

requiredEvidence: Bind vLLM exact revision 3bb0a03f35269185b6358753e64932bb946cc531 for feature evaluation; any later runnable revision must be separately exact-pinned and may not inherit qualification silently.
Reproduce acceptance-estimator slot-to-batch mapping, cudagraph padded-row isolation, probability calculation and online refit behavior with deterministic CUDA fixtures.
Compare adaptive-estimator verification with the existing full-block baseline under fixed prompts, seeds and exact model bytes; prove emitted-output correctness before measuring speed.
Measure accepted and rejected token accounting, estimator calibration error, throughput and latency across concurrency/load regimes without converting upstream behavior into an SZL performance claim.
Prove fail-fast behavior for enforce-eager or missing full cudagraph support, LoRA, pipeline parallelism and attention backends that cannot tolerate device-decided query lengths.
Exercise cancellation, request removal/reordering, cudagraph padding, restart, estimator cold start and rollback to the incumbent non-adaptive path.
Treat the upstream documentation/code support disagreement as an evidence gap: runtime behavior and exact tests govern qualification, not the broader inferred capability.
Preserve the exact DeepSeek V4.1 model/protocol/artifact gates in Frontier #134; this runtime successor cannot authorize the model or provider route independently.
